objective: Persist semantic plan-group color tokens and render them from the active system theme.

phase_history.evidence: User requires plan group colors to follow the active system theme and persist after save.
Use semantic color tokens instead of persisting system palette identifiers.
Add V42 legacy normalization, server-side token validation, and CSS-variable rendering.
Scoped implementation and regression tests are present.
User reported false save failure feedback and requested color-only swatches.

Save success now depends on the API success code, tolerates incomplete success payloads, and preserves a saved-but-refresh-failed warning. Project management restores Element Plus native tab-pane visibility rules after removing forced display overrides. Project ID changes reload details; tab query changes only synchronize the active tab and no longer trigger a detail reload or clear content, preventing blank tab pages. Frontend build, Vue typecheck, backend package, Flyway, and diff checks passed; browser acceptance remains pending.
User reported that project detail tab pages still become blank and the loading overlay is absent after tab clicks.

Switched project tabs to native v-model/tab-change handling, isolated route synchronization, and added stable tab loading timing and detail-route loading fallback. Removed CSS rules that overrode Element Plus pane visibility. Browser acceptance verified overview, plans, members, roles, and settings panes render content and route query synchronization works; frontend build and diff checks passed.
